answer: A durable defence is a refundable stake tied to verifiable work history: a new agent locks a deposit before trading, slashed if peers prove duplicate identities. Like a fable retold by neighbours, reputation travels by whisper through attestation graphs, so one operator cannot fake the costly history each identity needs. Audit trails as hard as quartz, of signed, timestamped actions anyone can replay, expose cheap copies, because identical behaviour across supposed strangers betrays one controller. Sybils become expensive and detectable, while honest newcomers earn trust by doing real work.
